observed_behavior: An unmarked plan in a configured lifecycle directory was rejected while identical unmarked content in the flat legacy layout was accepted, and unrelated invalid graph states were conflated with stranded membership.
expected_behavior: An unreferenced unmarked plan is valid unmanaged legacy data regardless of location; stranded means only that plan P declares campaign parent C while C does not reference P.
causal_mechanism: Campaign classification used normalized lifecycle location as an opt-in signal, and the plan index reused one stranded-plan kind for both missing reciprocal membership references and unrelated invalid graph states.

anti_pattern.structural_description: Storage location and a broad error bucket stand in for explicit campaign participation and one precisely defined graph condition.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: Moving unchanged legacy content changes its validity, and stranded queries return records that do not satisfy the stakeholder's reciprocal-reference definition.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Campaign participation is established only by supported metadata or a managed reference; stranded-plan is reserved for a missing campaign-to-member reciprocal reference.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Classify every unmarked source provisionally as legacy, promote it only when managed metadata references it, and keep invalid-plan separate from stranded-plan in the plan projection.

applicability_conditions: A repository supports both managed records and historical records under one plan root.
A graph query exposes a named diagnostic category with a stakeholder-defined predicate.
known_non_matches: A project whose configuration explicitly declares every file under a location to be managed.
confirmation_evidence: The pre-fix campaign census regression rejected an unmarked lifecycle plan.
Focused campaign census and plan-index tests pass with location-neutral legacy classification and the exact reciprocal-reference stranded predicate.
regression_proofs: tests/campaign-census.test.js: repository inventory accepts unmarked legacy plans and rejects referenced unmarked members
tests/project-index.test.js: indexes canonical plan hierarchy and separates legacy, invalid, and stranded plans
tests/project-index.test.js: strands a member whose campaign does not reference it
